menu.name: Macro hotkeys
menu.label: Configure hotkeys
menu.hint: Bind macros to key combinations that also work while typing in text fields, chat and editors.

Config.title: Macro Hotkeys
Config.intro: These hotkeys also fire while you type in a text field. Click the key field and press the combination; Backspace clears it, Escape cancels.

user.title: My hotkeys
user.hint: Only for you. They take precedence over the hotkeys for everyone.

world.title: Hotkeys for everyone
world.hint: Defined by the GM, active for every user (if they may execute the macro).

Config.recordTooltip: Click and press a key combination
Config.overridesWorld: Replaces a hotkey for everyone with the same keys.
Config.overriddenByUser: Replaced for you by one of your own hotkeys.
Config.fixProblems: Please fix the marked hotkeys first.

Problems.needsModifier: Needs Ctrl or Alt (only F1–F24 work alone), otherwise typing breaks.
Problems.protected: This key is reserved for the browser.
Problems.duplicate: These keys are used twice in this list.

Errors.macroMissing: Macro hotkey: the macro {uuid} no longer exists.
Errors.noPermission: Macro hotkey: you may not execute the macro "{name}".
Errors.macroFailed: Macro hotkey: the macro "{name}" failed, see the console.
